name: R002-minun-charm-hyper-cutter
why: Challenge 2. The opponent leads Minun (set 292: Thunderbolt, Attract, Charm, Wish). The player leads Pinsir (set 369), whose only ability is Hyper Cutter, so get_ability reads Hyper Cutter with no guess. Every turn the AI scores Charm (EFFECT_ATTACK_DOWN_2) through AI_CBM_AttackDown (battle_ai_scripts.s:277-281): the target's Attack is not at -6 and its ability is Hyper Cutter, so -10, the runCbmAttackDown Hyper Cutter branch. It runs in the first AI turn already. Pinsir uses Swords Dance / Endure, so it stays in for a few turns; Gligar 315 (Hyper Cutter or Sand Veil) is the second chance.
